import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] arrayLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        long[] a = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Long.parseLong(arrayLine[i]);
        }

        int mid = n / 2;

        List<Long> firstHalf = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Long> secondHalf = new ArrayList<>();

        generateSumsLeft(a, 0, 0, mid, m, firstHalf);
        generateSumsRight(a, mid, n, 0, m, secondHalf);

        // Remove duplicates and sort
        TreeSet<Long> uniqueLeftSet = new TreeSet<>(firstHalf);
        List<Long> uniqueLeft = new ArrayList<>(uniqueLeftSet);

        long maxSumFound = 0;

        for (Long val : secondHalf) {
            long target = m - val;
            int position = Collections.binarySearch(uniqueLeft, target);
            if (position < 0) {
                position = -position - 1;
            }
            if (position > 0) {
                long candidateSum = uniqueLeft.get(position - 1) + val;
                if (candidateSum > maxSumFound) {
                    maxSumFound = candidateSum;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxSumFound);
    }

    private static void generateSumsLeft(long[] a, int index, long total, int limit, int m, List<Long> result) {
        if (index == limit) {
            result.add(total);
        } else {
            generateSumsLeft(a, index + 1, (total + a[index]) % m, limit, m, result);
            generateSumsLeft(a, index + 1, total, limit, m, result);
        }
    }

    private static void generateSumsRight(long[] a, int start, int end, long total, int m, List<Long> result) {
        if (start == end) {
            result.add(total);
        } else {
            generateSumsRight(a, start + 1, end, (total + a[start]) % m, m, result);
            generateSumsRight(a, start + 1, end, total, m, result);
        }
    }
